item.title: Immigration officials defend approach at House hearing
item.description: From left, Rodney Scott, commissioner of Customs and Border Protection, Joseph Edlow, director of Citizenship and Immigration Services, and Todd Lyons, acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testify Tuesday during the House Homeland Security Committee hearing on immigration enforcement.

item.title: Bondi to face criticism over Epstein disclosure law at House hearing
item.description: Attorney General Pamela Bondi conducts a news conference in December 2025 at the Department of Justice announcing the arrest of a person suspected of placing pipe bombs near the Republican and Democratic national committee offices on Jan. 6, 2021.

item.title: How the Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks explain the 2026 midterms
item.description: Running back Kenneth Walker III, right, and quarterback Sam Darnold celebrate after the Seattle Seahawks won the Super Bowl over the New England Patriots in Santa Clara, Calif., on Sunday.

item.title: As colleagues wind down their careers, Rosa DeLauro is staying put
item.description: Connecticut Rep. Rosa DeLauro is seeking a 19th term this year.

item.title: Lawmakers stress need for immigration site visits without delays
item.description: Protesters confront federal agents last month outside the Metropolitan Detention Center in downtown Los Angeles, part of nationwide demonstrations sparked by outrage over the recent deaths of Alex Pretti and Renee Good at the hands of federal immigration agents.

item.description: Maine Sen. Susan Collins leaves the Republican Senate luncheon in the U.S. Capitol on Tuesday. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)

item.title: Despite impasse on CR, Thune pushes forward on DHS spending bill
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., speaks during the Senate Republicans’ news conference in the Ohio Clock Corridor in the Capitol on Tuesday. Sen. John Barrasso, R-Wyo., stands to the left.

item.title: House rejects rule that would block floor votes to end tariffs
item.description: Rep. Kevin Kiley, R-Calif., seen here at a House Judiciary Committee hearing in the Rayburn House Office Building on Jan. 22, was among the GOP lawmakers who voted against the rule.
